baseline_prompt_en: Adult guild members at an isekai frontier guild review quests and passage permits before the seasonal caravan departs. The members stand beside a desk with route records while loaded wagons wait beyond the doorway. One member places a permit beside the route map with a hand resting on the desk edge.
